name: Rivet Engine
description: Build and scale stateful workloads with long-lived processes
composeYaml:
services:
  rivet-engine:
    image: 'rivetdev/engine:2.2.0'
    environment:
      - RIVET__FILE_SYSTEM__PATH=/data
      - 'RIVET__AUTH__ADMIN_TOKEN=${TOKEN}'
    volumes:
      - 'rivet-data:/data'
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD
        - curl
        - '-f'
        - 'http://127.0.0.1:6420/health'
      interval: 2s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 10
      start_period: 30s
